checkRuns.command:
bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo built; PORT=4567 bun run start > /tmp/bookshelf.log 2>&1 & 
sleep 2; cp /tmp/e2e.mjs ./e2e.tmp.mjs && bun e2e.tmp.mjs; rm e2e.tmp.mjs

printf -- '---
title: A Test Book
author: Tess Ter
year: 1900
rating: 5
tags: [zzz]
---

Body **bold**.
' > content/books/a-test-book.md
bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; ls dist/client/books/; grep -o 'A Test Book' dist/client/index.html; grep -o 'data-tag="zzz"' dist/client/books/index.html
rm content/books/a-test-book.md

kill $(ss -ltnp | grep ':4567' | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2) 2>&1; rm e2e.tmp.mjs; bun remove playwright-core >/dev/null 2>&1; cmp package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && echo pkg-restored; git diff --stat bun.lock; bun run check 2>&1 | grep -A3 Result; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1; sleep 1; ss -ltn | grep 4567 || echo "no server"; git status --short
